{c_important}Mobility{/c} Skills are always {c_important}Shadow Imbued{/c} with {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased potency. 

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Damaging an Elite or Boss with a {c_important}Mobility{/c} Skill has up to a {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|%|]{/c} chance to instantly trigger a free {c_important}Shadow Imbuement{/c} explosion.
